responsibility: This file implements the non-inline algorithms for vec_perm_indices, GCC’s canonical representation of constant vector permutation masks used by vector lowering and target vector-permute matching. It builds canonical encodings from permutation builders, expands and shrinks permutations across element-splitting factors, rotates inputs, recognizes series and range properties of encoded permutations, and converts between the internal representation and TREE VECTOR_CST or RTL CONST_VECTOR forms, with selftests covering representative pattern queries.
same_name_distinction: Implements the substantive vec_perm_indices algorithms and TREE/RTL conversion routines—such as canonicalization, expansion/shrinking, rotation, series/range analysis, and constant-vector conversion—whereas gcc/vec-perm-indices.h mainly declares the class, stored state, and inline accessors/predicates.
